label: Hashing AND nodes
subgoals: Normalize each node's pair of input literals
Look the pair up in the hash table
Merge on a hit and count only the nodes created

label: Cascading merges
subgoals: Replace each input literal by its representative
Recompute the node's key after the replacement
Merge whenever the updated key already exists

label: Trivial simplifications
subgoals: Apply AND(x, x) = x and AND(x, not x) = 0 before hashing
Propagate the resulting aliases and constants to the readers
Count the AND nodes that remain in the table
